<div class="card-body">
'''Besieged''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">完全包囲</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">捕まっている宇宙船に配備する。スター・デストロイヤー（あるいは「ドッキング・ベイ327」）にいる自分のキャラクターは、捕まっている宇宙船の中の敵のキャラクターたちに対して戦闘を行える。もし自分のキャラクターが全滅したら、宇宙船は逃亡する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Besieged-PSA-161939267.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパーはタンティヴィIVのメイン・エアロックを焼き切った。反乱軍兵士たちは必死で侵入を阻止したが、帝国軍の圧倒的な火力の前にはなすすべもなかった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Complete encirclement.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on a captured starship. Your characters on a Star Destroyer (or at Docking Bay 327) may battle the enemy characters aboard the captured starship. If your characters are all lost, the starship flees.

'''Lore:'''
Stormtroopers burned through the main airlock of Tantive IV. Rebel soldiers desperately tried to stop the intrusion, but they were helpless before the Empire's overwhelming firepower.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 完全包囲 (complete encirclement). Japanese omits “as if at a site.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Besieged]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
